# dtcloud_volume_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists the snapshots taken of one volume.

Read-only on purpose: snapshots are managed by `dtcloud_snapshot`, and creating one here would put two
resources in charge of the same object. What this is for is seeing what a destroy would take with
it, since deleting a volume deletes its snapshots too.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_volume_snapshots" "of_data_volume" {
  volume_id = dtcloud_volume.data.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume whose snapshots to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `snapshots` (List of Object) Snapshots of the volume, newest first — the API sorts by creation date descending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `created_on` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `storage_policy` (String)

## Behaviour worth knowing

* **Newest first**, as the API sorts them by creation date.
* **A volume with no snapshots returns an empty list**; a volume that does not exist is an error.
